evidence.title: Confidence decay defaults
evidence.content: The default uniform decay rate is 10 percent confidence loss per month. Memories below the 0.2 prune floor get dropped during prune sweeps.

evidence.title: Tuning history note
evidence.content: Three retired research-shaped skills declared a slower 0.05 per month decay rate and a 0.1 prune floor. Those values were not promoted to defaults.
